fixture.purpose: Smallest dense periodic cut-off-only 9-6 cluster with a near-cutoff attractive cross-pair.
fixture.why_dense: Four charged atoms create two close contacts plus a 0.905 nm cross-pair inside one periodic box.
fixture.why_minimal: Four atoms are enough to create both local crowding and pairlist-sensitive cross interactions without transport-scale complexity.
fixture.closer_to_tp1_3_than_tp1_5_toys: Unlike the sparse exclusion and 2-atom shift toys, this fixture combines charge, density, multiple simultaneous nonbonded contacts, and a near-cutoff cross-pair.

trace_note: TP1.5c uses env-var-gated inner/outer pairlist and final-force tracing on the TP1.5b dense_nonlisted fixture.
